name: Lac Operon Regulation
description: The lac operon is a classic example of prokaryotic gene regulation discovered by Jacob and Monod. It demonstrates how E. coli regulates the genes needed for lactose metabolism in response to environmental glucose and lactose levels through transcriptional control involving the lac repressor, CAP-cAMP complex, and RNA polymerase.
